Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Single Server now available in Brazil Southeast

Body.Content: Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Single Server is now available in preview in the Brazil Southeast region. You now have additional flexibility in deploying solutions to help accelerate innovation and better support people working to transform their businesses. Learn more about the current regional availability of Azure Database for PostgreSQL products.
